8.6.3 Sample-Clocked Meter & Probe Pipeline (Select -> Filter -> Group/Aggregate)#

Both meter capture and probe capture run sample-locked across any Take span (--range) and support up to 4 simultaneous graph probe points (raw_in, post_anchor, pre_slot:<0..7|slug>, post_slot:<0..7|slug>, sc_key:<0..7|slug>, post_rack, post_fader, post_pdc, aux_send:<0..7>, master_pre_mon, monitor_out, hw_adc:<0..17>):

  1. Select & Pre-Condition: Filter by --channel (left, right, mid, side, mono_sum), --band-filter (lowpass, highpass, bandpass, k_weight), and --diff-mode (raw_diff, gain_matched_null) for exact A/B transfer checks.
  2. Filter (--where): Restrict analysis to matching frames or events via predicates on rms_dbfs, peak_dbfs, true_peak_dbtp, lufs_m, lufs_s, gr_db, phase_corr, abs_sample, clipped, gate_open, sample_clock, or transport_sample.
  3. Group & Aggregate (--group-by / --agg): Aggregate over whole, bucket:<stride>, or contiguous_event spans using basic, dynamics, spectral, forensic, or transfer profiles (reporting top_peaks_hz, fundamental_hz, gain_delta_db, crest_delta_db, gcc_phat_lag_us, and transfer_curve_31band_db), outputting compact summary-json (default), 32-bit float Broadcast Wave wav, binary f32le, or bounded samples-json.

8.6.4 Zero-Dependency Python Client (extras/python/caverec.py) & 6 Embedded Studio Skills#

Every direct distribution ships extras/python/caverec.py (Python 3.10+, standard library only), providing sub-0.2 ms round-trip control over a persistent caverec-cli stream --ndjson session:

from caverec import CaveRecClient

with CaveRecClient.connect_live() as studio:
    summary = studio.state_dump(only_non_default=True)
    with studio.atomic_batch("Vocal polish"):
        studio.call("strip", "fader", "--track", "17", "--db", "-1.5")
        studio.call("rack", "eq-band", "--track", "17", "--band", "1", "--type", "hpf", "--freq", "90")
    metrics = studio.capture_meters(take=1, meters=["lufs", "true_peak", "crest", "phase"])

Cave Recorder also embeds 6 Studio Engineering Skills (caverec-cli skills list / caverec-cli skills install) covering every studio discipline: caverec-session-assistant, caverec-tracking-and-restoration, caverec-mix-console-engineer, caverec-groove-and-sampler-producer, caverec-stagebox-live-engineer, and caverec-mastering-and-delivery. Note that caverec-headless also preserves all legacy hardware verification flags (--list-devices, --synthetic, --self-test, --device-id, --channels, --sample-rate, --duration-secs, --preroll-secs, --output-dir).

Part IV · Chapter 9

Studio Glossary & Alphabetical Index

Canonical definitions of Cave Recorder terminology, Take vs. Pass disambiguation, Plain Studio Language conventions, Studio Coach, Stagebox Mixer (MY MONITOR, FULL MIXER, MIXER LOCK, SENDS ON FADERS, Virtual Soundcheck), MIDI Sync, Pre-Tape Virtual Instrument, Groovebox and Studio Sampler, Hardware Direct Monitoring, Studio Pad Surface, multi-camera video, Cave Companion mobile (Sample Studio Session and Bonjour discovery), caverec-cli and Studio Engineering Skills, and an alphabetical subject index.

This chapter defines the canonical studio terminology used across every console faceplate, timeline lane, session file, and workflow in Cave Recorder (caverec), followed by the complete Alphabetical Index of the manual.

9.1 Take vs. Pass Disambiguation (Quick Guide)#

Traditional desktop digital audio workstations use the word "Take" for both an entire song recording and an overdubbed layer on a single track, causing constant confusion during band rehearsals. Cave Recorder enforces a strict four-tier studio hierarchy where Session-level Takes and Track-level Passes are completely distinct concepts:

Project (Band / Artist Workspace, e.g., GF)
 └── Session (Rehearsal Night or Tracking Day, e.g., GF_20261020-1)
      └── Take (Complete Song Run-Through Starting at 00:00:00.000)
           └── Pass (Single-Track Stem Inside That Take: PASS 01 / OD 02)
Studio Term & Level UI Badge & Location On-Disk Pattern How It Is Created & Used
Project (Level 1: Band or venture) PROJECT modal (CMD/CTRL + O) <LibraryRoot>/<ProjectTag>/ Top-level band folder containing all Sessions plus a unified _Mixes/ folder for rapid listening and cloud sharing.
Session (Level 2: Rehearsal or studio day) Session pill in Top Deck & TAKES (CMD/CTRL + 5) <ProjectTag>/<SessionID>_<Tag>/ Defines the room's 18-channel microphone patch, strip names, bus routing, and console processing shared across all Takes recorded that day.
Take (Level 3: Complete song or jam at t = 0) < TAKE 001 > in Top Deck & TAKES CATALOG Take<NNN>_<Stamp>[_<TakeTag>]/ Created whenever you press Record (R) with OVERDUB off. Every Take starts at its own 00:00:00.000 origin and is never stacked on top of another Take.
Base Pass (Level 4A: Initial track stem) PASS 01 (BASE PASS) on strip & Pass Lane rec/*_<CC>-<Name>_Rec001_<Stamp>.wav The initial 32-bit float pre-fader mono stem captured on a record-armed channel strip when the Take was first recorded from 00:00:00.000.
Overdub Pass (Level 4B: Layered track stem) OD 02, OD 03 (OVERDUB) on strip & Pass Lane rec/*_<CC>-<Name>_Rec<MMM>-OD_<Stamp>.wav A subsequent track-level recording captured inside the currently active Take when OVERDUB (O) is latched on the Top Deck.
Pass Lanes (Track sub-lanes inside a Take) PASSES (E / SHIFT + E) in TIMELINE Stored in *_Take<NNN>_take.json Expandable vertical sub-lanes under a track displaying its PASS 01 Base Pass and OD 02..N Overdub Passes for one-click comp selection (Use PASS 01 / ★ OD 02).
Pass Lanes Are Never Called Take Lanes

In Cave Recorder, track-level overdub lanes under a channel are always called Pass Lanes (PASS 01, OD 02, OD 03) and are never called "Take Lanes", and the project and session browser modal is always labeled PROJECT and is never called a "Welcome Screen" or "Welcome Dialog". A Take (TAKE 001, TAKE 002) is always an entire multitrack song performance starting at 00:00:00.000, while a Pass is a single track's recording layer inside that Take.

9.2 Studio Glossary#

The alphabetical definitions below cover every core studio concept, signal-processing stage, console switch, and workflow term in Cave Recorder, with direct links to the chapters where each topic is covered in depth.

12-Band Parametric EQ (2:12B EQ)#

Zero-latency 12-band precision state-variable parametric equalizer (B1 through B12) available in the 8-slot processor rack of every Input Track (CH01..CH32) and Subgroup Bus (SUB 1..SUB 16). Each band provides -24.0 dB to +24.0 dB gain across 20 Hz to 20 kHz, variable Q (0.10 to 18.00), and seven selectable filter shapes: peaking Bell (BELL), Low Shelf (LSHF), High Shelf (HSHF), High-Pass Filter (HPF), Low-Pass Filter (LPF), surgical Notch (NTCH), and Spectral Tilt (TILT). See Section 5.3.

30-Minute Retroactive Capture (● RETRO / SAVE RETRO)#

Continuous background audio capture system that retains the most recent 30 minutes of live 32-bit floating-point audio across all record-armed (R) input channels in system memory whenever ● RETRO is lit in the Top Transport Deck. Clicking SAVE RETRO (or pressing SHIFT + R) flushes the rolling 30-minute memory to disk as a new numbered Session Take (Take<NNN>) so spontaneous jams played while the transport was stopped are never lost. See Section 1.1.2, Section 2.2.3, and Section 3.2.

8-Slot Processor Rack#

Multi-instance reorderable eight-slot insert processing chain (Slots 1..8) on every Input Track and Subgroup Bus. Any built-in zero-latency studio processor (2:12B EQ, 3:VCA CMP, 4:AUX SND movable send tap, Amp Rig, standalone Cabinet & IR Loader, Tape Saturation, Context-Aware Gate, De-Esser, Vocal Rider, Transient Shaper, Ladder Filter, Modulation, Micro-Pitch Doubler, Gain Utility, or Signal Repair) or third-party .clap and macOS Audio Unit (AUv3 / AUv2) plugin can be inserted in one or more slots across the same strip with independent per-slot state and telemetry. Clicking any slot opens the inline SLOT N PROCESSOR picker to swap processor types, assign an installed plugin, open a floating PLUGIN GUI window, or preserve an uninstalled plugin as a non-destructive Ghost Slot (! MISSING). Slots can be reordered live during playback by dragging their :: handle or clicking ^ / v with clickless crossfading, or bypassed individually via B. See Section 4.1, Section 5.1.3, and Section 5.7.3.

Active Comp Lane (ACTIVE COMP LANE)#

The single Pass Lane currently selected for disk playback on a track inside the active Take. Highlighted in amber-copper waveform color with a green star badge (★ PASS 01 or ★ OD 02) in WAVEFORM TIMELINE (CMD/CTRL + 2) and reflected on the channel strip's gold pass indicator badge on the Mix Console. See Section 3.4 and Section 6.2.2.

Amp Dynamic Gate (AMP DYNAMIC)#

High-gain guitar and bass variant of the Context-Aware 3-Variant Noise Gate engineered for stoner rock, doom, psychedelic rock, and tube/fuzz rigs. Combines an autocorrelation pitch periodicity detector with a spectral flatness detector so whisper-quiet -34 dBFS clean fingerpicked notes (Whisper Clean Lock) and intentional 1.5 s to 5.0 s (default 2.5 s) harmonic cabinet feedback swells (Feedback Bloom Lock) remain wide open, while 50/60 Hz hum and fuzz hiss clamp shut in 15 ms to 40 ms (default 18 ms to 22 ms) on a palm-mute stop (Palm-Mute Clamp) along a click-free S-curve with split-band HF Tame de-hissing. See Section 5.4.5.

Amp Rig & Neural Amp Capture ([CIR] / [NAM] / HEAD ON/BYP / CAP)#

Zero-latency guitar and bass amplifier, cabinet, and neural capture insert processor available in any of the 8 rack slots on Input Tracks and Subgroup Buses. Operates in either [CIR] Circuit Mode (modeling 8 vacuum-tube preamp and power-amp topologies with 2x / 4x anti-aliasing oversampling) or [NAM] Neural Capture Mode (running open .nam neural amplifier models alongside 8 modeled speaker cabinets and custom .wav/.nam linear impulse responses), with independent HEAD ON/BYP and CAB BYP switches for pairing an amplifier head with downstream stereo effects and a standalone Cabinet & IR Loader slot. Includes a guided 3-step Hardware Amp & Pedal Capture Wizard (CAP) supporting three training quality modes (Standard 150 training passes, Mastering up to 1,000 training passes with held-out validation checkpointing, adaptive step-size refinement, automatic convergence early stopping, and interactive STOP & KEEP BEST, and Turbo 60 training passes), live training and validation ESR metering (STUDIO < 1% ESR), and automatic replication into <SessionFolder>/models/ and <TakeFolder>/models/ for portable cloud sync. See Section 5.4.6.

Analog Bass Voice (ANALOG BASS / BAS)#

Fifth circuit archetype in Cave Recorder's native Virtual Analog Drum Machine & Melodic Groove Sequencer (Analog Violet badge BAS, BASS archetype keycap). Pairs an oversampled band-limited sawtooth-to-variable-width-pulse VCO and phase-locked -1 oct flip-flop sub / dual-VCO beat blend with a unified 4-pole filter morphing smoothly from an uncompensated transistor ladder (with a 24 Hz pedal-bass sub-coupling bump) to a passband-compensated OTA filter, pre-filter drive with VCA feedback, asymmetric post-filter multi-drive, and analog accent coupling. Exposes a contextual Bass Voice Setup Strip (ROOT, FINE ±100 ct, GLIDE 0..500 ms, G: SLIDE / ALWAYS, ENV: RETRG / LEGTO / GATE, and MIDI: CHRM / PAD chromatic keyboard routing), melodic [2D | NOTE | VEL] step-grid gestures with violet Tie Bridge Bars, Storage-CRT XY reticles (CUTOFF × RESONANCE and ENV MOD × DRIVE), and curated factory presets in ACID & FUNK (ACID SQUELCH), STUDIO ANALOG, and SOUL POCKET (FUNK POCKET). See Section 5.9.2.

Analog VCA Compressor (3:VCA CMP)#

Zero-latency voltage-controlled amplifier dynamics processor included in every Input Track and Subgroup Bus 8-slot rack. Provides adjustable Threshold (-60.0 dB to 0.0 dB), Ratio (1.0:1 to 20.0:1 with 2:1, 4:1, 8:1, and 20:1 presets), Attack (0.1 ms to 100.0 ms), Release (10.0 ms to 1000.0 ms), Makeup Gain (0.0 dB to +24.0 dB), a 90 Hz Sidechain High-Pass Filter (SC HPF, shortcut H in Channel Inspector), Stereo Link (LINK), New York parallel blend (MIX 50%), and a real-time Gain Reduction (GR) trace. See Section 5.4.

Async Job Status Bar (⟳ Job % ✕)#

Top-Deck background task progress and cancellation pill automatically shown whenever an offline Master BOUNCE, Take Export…, Print conversion, Take split, timeline audio surgery ([REPAIR CLIPPING], [SMOOTH OVER ARTIFACT]), Studio Sampler bank load or bounce, Plugin RESCAN, Cloud upload/download, or neural amp capture runs asynchronously off the 60 Hz interface thread. Protected by automatic session-switch safety guards and transactional rollback on disk or network interruption. Click ✕ to cancel a running job cleanly without disturbing audio playback. See Section 1.3.2.

Audio Settings Modal (AUDIO SETTINGS)#

Hardware configuration dialog opened via AUDIO SETTINGS in the Top Deck (CMD + , on macOS, CTRL + , on Windows and Linux). Selects the physical input and output audio interface, sample rate (44.1, 48.0, 88.2, or 96.0 kHz), hardware buffer size (32 to 2048 frames), checks macOS Microphone permission status, runs automated hardware impulse loopback latency calibration (Measure Latency), displays Dual-Screen Pad Controller USB diagnostics, and provides one-click installation of caverec-cli and the 6 embedded Studio Engineering Skills. See Section 2.2 and Section 2.3.

Audio Unit (AUv2 & AUv3 on macOS)#

Native macOS audio effect ('aufx'), music effect ('aumf'), and Music Device instrument ('aumu') plugins instantiated out-of-process by default for crash and sandbox isolation. In the Mac App Store edition, Audio Units are the exclusive third-party plugin format (PLUGINS hides .clap controls), while direct downloads from caverec.app host both .clap and Audio Unit plugins. See Section 2.1.4 and Section 5.7.

Aux Return (AUX 1 REVERB & AUX 2 TAPE DLY .. AUX 8)#

Up to eight dedicated, solo-safe stereo effect return strips (AUX 1 through AUX 8, dynamically added via + AUX) on the right side of the Mixer feeding the Master Bus. See Section 4.3.2 and Section 5.5.

Aux Send (RVB & DLY / PRE, EQ, POST)#

Per-channel and per-subgroup stereo send level controls (-inf to +12.0 dB) feeding AUX 1 REVERB (RVB) and AUX 2 TAPE DLY (DLY), paired with a 3-way pickoff tap selector: PRE (pre-insert and pre-fader), EQ (post-EQ and pre-fader), or POST (post-fader and post-mute). See Section 4.2.3.

Base Pass (Rec001 / PASS 01)#

The initial multitrack audio stem captured on a record-armed channel strip when a Session Take is originally recorded from 00:00:00.000 with OVERDUB turned off. Stored on disk in <TakeFolder>/rec/<SessionID>_Take<NNN>_<CC>-<TrackName>_Rec001_<Stamp>.wav and displayed as PASS 01 (BASE PASS) in the channel strip header and Pass Lanes. See Section 1.2 and Section 6.2.

Bonjour Studio Discovery (_caverec._udp)#

Zero-configuration local network advertising on macOS (_caverec._udp) paired with UDP studio discovery so iOS and Android Cave Companion apps automatically list available studio workstations on the PAIR screen with zero manual IP entry. See Section 7.6.1.

Cab IR (Speaker Cabinet & Linear Impulse Response Loader)#

Standalone reorderable speaker cabinet and linear impulse response (IR) convolution rack processor (SPEAKER CABINET & IR LOADER) available in any of the 8 rack slots on Input Tracks and Subgroup Buses. Provides 8 modeled physical speaker enclosures (2x12, 4x12 25, 4x12 75, 4x12 BR, 4x12 TG, 4x12 OV, 4x12 15, and 8x10), 5 studio microphone capsule models (DYN-C, DYN-L, RBN-8, CND-L, DYN-B), continuous MIC POS and ROOM AIR, an interactive MIC HPF × MIC LPF (20..500 Hz × 2..20 kHz) 2D XY spectral contour pad, and zero-allocation time-domain FIR convolution (EXT IR, up to 2048 taps per channel) for custom mono/stereo .wav and .nam ("Linear") impulse responses managed through the three-tier (Take -> Session -> Global) [CAB IR] browser. Enables placing stereo modulation, delay, or reverb rack slots between an Amp Rig head (CAB BYP enabled) and the speaker cabinet. See Section 5.4.7.

Camera Latency Calibration (3-Second 4-Pulse Optical & Acoustic Calibration)#

Automated 3-second (34,320-sample at 48.0 kHz) optical and acoustic calibration workflow (CALIBRATE CAMERA LATENCY) supporting three desktop modes (4-Pulse Vernier Flash for external cameras, Full-Window White Flash for built-in laptop webcams facing the room, and Interactive Clapper / Hand Clap -5..+5 frame-stepping inspector) plus Cave Companion mobile direct wireless-clock Rear LED Torch 4-Pulse Calibration (FLASH SYNC ▾ drawer, calibrating rolling-shutter and encoder delay directly against wireless studio-clock timestamps with no phone speaker or microphone audio loop). Stores calibrated camera latency per hardware device in session.json so every recorded .vididx sidecar index locks visually to the 48.0 kHz audio timeline. See Section 2.5.2 and Section 7.6.3.

Cave Companion Mobile App (Android .apk & iOS .ipa)#

Native mobile studio companion application (Android API 36 / 16 KB page-size compliant caverec-v0.7.1-android-arm64.apk and iOS caverec-v0.7.1-ios-arm64.ipa) paired with the desktop workstation via ● REMOTE (CMD/CTRL + 0), zero-configuration Bonjour (_caverec._udp) Wi-Fi discovery, 6-digit MATCH CODE approval banner, QR code, or 6-digit Studio PIN. Presents 8 root tabs on tablets (PAIR | TRANSPORT | MIXER | STAGEBOX | GROOVEBOX | CAMERA | TAKES | PLAYER) and 6 root tabs on phones (PAIR | TRANSPORT | CONSOLE [MIXER | GROOVEBOX | STAGEBOX] | CAMERA | TAKES | PLAYER), plus the offline SAMPLE STUDIO SESSION (UNPAIRED SAMPLE) powered by the real studio engine (including hydrated STAGEBOX MY MONITOR and FULL MIXER exploration), universal [M][S][R] Solo Gold strip controls, Stagebox MY MONITOR vs. PIN-lockable FULL MIXER (MIXER LOCK), and Android FULL immersive taskbar mode. See Section 3.7 and Section 7.6.

Channel Strip (CHANNEL STRIP)#

Full-screen single-channel, Subgroup Bus, Aux Return, and Master Bus processing workbench (CMD + 3 on macOS, CTRL + 3 on Windows and Linux). Combines a full-height channel strip on the left with the top Signal-Flow Chain & Layout Mode Bar (SPLIT, CHAIN LANE, EQ+CMP, and HIDE TL / SHOW TL), expanded 12-band Parametric EQ and Dual-Trace RTA, VCA/FET/Opto Compressor with scrolling Gain Reduction trace, full-height Large Processor Views with 2D XY Control Pads, multi-bus output routing popover, and collapsible Mini-Timeline. See Section 5.1.2.

CLAP Plugin (1:PLUGIN & [INST])#

Third-party audio effect or Pre-Tape Virtual Instrument plugin conforming to the open CLAP (Clever Audio Plug-in, .clap) standard in direct downloads across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Audio effects host in any of the eight reorderable rack slots (1:PLUGIN..8:PLUGIN) using format-agnostic Plugin rack chrome, while CLAP instruments host at the Pre-Tape Track Input Stage ([INST]). Supports out-of-process catalog indexing in PLUGINS (CMD/CTRL + 7), native floating windows (PLUGIN GUI), non-destructive Ghost Slot recovery, automatic PDC, and LOW-LATENCY bypass. See Section 5.7.

Cloud Sync (CLOUD)#

Built-in two-way Google Drive synchronization engine for backing up Sessions and collaborating across bandmates' computers (MIXES vs. FULL transfer tiers, AUTO-FLAC ON UPLOAD, AUTO-MP3 ON UPLOAD, federated + Link Remote Project…, exclusive session write-locking with persistent READ-ONLY PREVIEW banner, and Snapshot-backed conflict merging). See Section 7.5.

Console DAW Remote ([CONSOLE DAW REMOTE])#

Second operating personality of a connected Studio Pad Surface (● CONTROLLER), framed in 4 px Console Burgundy (or Warm Preamp Copper in STAGEBOX PREAMPS). Dedicates GROUPS A..H to 8-channel strip banking (Tracks 1..32, Subgroups 1..16, Aux Returns 1..8, Master), maps MIX to 8-channel [M][S][R] Solo Gold faders and guarded 600 ms +48V Stagebox preamps, maps CHANNEL -> F1: AUX SENDS to dual-screen AUX 1..8 encoders, maps PLUG-IN to built-in Processor curves and hosted Plugin (CLAP/AU) pages, maps the 16 pads to SCENE Ranges, PAD MODE Cue Markers, and PATTERN Pass Lane comping, maps SAMPLING to CONSOLE CAPTURE & RESAMPLE, and exposes guarded Disk Take recording with the Active Take Stop Guard. See Section 4.5 and Section 8.5.3.

Control Room Monitor Bar (MONITOR: & AUTO LEVEL)#

Speaker-check and loudness-matched audition strip wired strictly downstream of the Master Bus 2-TRK PRINT live stereo Print tap and offline BOUNCE engine. Includes 4-band Linkwitz-Riley (24 dB/oct) frequency isolation buttons (SUB < 90 Hz, LOW 90-350 Hz, MID 350 Hz - 3.5 kHz, HIGH > 3.5 kHz), unity-gain MONO fold-down, equal-power STEREO DIFF ((L - R) × 0.7071) side difference solo, DIM -20 speaker attenuation, and AUTO LEVEL loudness-matched processor/rack bypass. See Section 4.3.4.

Cycle Loop (⇄)#

Master Transport mode (C or clicking ⇄ in the Top Deck) that loops playback or overdub recording continuously between the START and END boundaries of the active Take Range (R001, R003, ...). See Section 3.4 and Section 6.3.2.

Drum Bleed Gate (DRUM BLEED)#

Percussion-focused variant of the Context-Aware 3-Variant Noise Gate designed to isolate rack and floor toms from loud snare and cymbal spill. Combines a resonant fundamental sidechain filter (Q = 4.0) with one-click [LRN] pitch auto-detection (55 Hz to 350 Hz, default 110 Hz), differential snare/cymbal spill rejection (E_key - α * E_ref), 1.5 ms lookahead with < 0.25 ms attack, and an envelope-driven dynamic decay low-pass filter (20 kHz sweeping down to an adjustable 250 Hz to 800 Hz cutoff, default 380 Hz) that removes hi-hat wash during tom ring-outs. See Section 5.4.5.

Drum Stem Breakout (STEM)#

Individual voice multi-out routing option inside the native Virtual Analog Drum Machine that removes a chosen drum voice (such as Kick, Snare, or Clap) from the internal Drum Master Glue Bus by default (preventing comb filtering) and routes its stereo output directly into a dedicated Mix Console channel strip at zero added latency for independent console EQ, compression, Aux 1..8 Reverb/Delay sends, raw .wav Pass recording, and 30-minute RETRO capture. See Section 5.9.1.

Drum Studio ([DRUM STUDIO] / PAD:DRUM)#

Primary instrument operating personality of a connected Studio Pad Surface dedicated to Cave Recorder's native Virtual Analog Drum Machine, ANALOG BASS synthesizer, and STUDIO SAMPLER. Combines 16 velocity- and pressure-sensitive pads (PAD MODE, KEYBOARD chromatic and folded scales, STEP MODE bottom-to-top 64-step sequencer, NOTE REPEAT, ARP, and ALL + NOTE REPEAT Slip Beat-Repeat pads), live Storage-CRT voice oscilloscope and 8-encoder macro control, the 4-tab SAMPLING workspace (RECORD | EDIT | SLICE | ZONE, split zero-crossing zoom, live pad-tap chop, and SHIFT + SAMPLING for STEM & SYNC), CTRL ALL sweeps, GROUPS A..H Pattern Banks and Morph Slots (and 64-slice banking in SLICE-LOCK), Pattern Overdub recording (REC = [● PAT OVR] only, never touching Disk Take recording), and live Drum Sequencer Dropout/Re-Entry via bare PLAY while a multitrack Disk Take rolls. See Section 3.9 and Section 5.10.2.

Dual-Trace Spectrum Analyzer (RTA)#

High-resolution real-time acoustic spectrum analyzer displayed behind the 12-Band Parametric EQ curve in both the Mix Console Upper Well 2 and the CHANNEL INSPECTOR view. Plots the pre-EQ input spectrum (darker shaded trace) and post-EQ output spectrum (bright emerald trace) simultaneously from 20 Hz to 20 kHz. See Section 5.3.2.

Export Take (EXPORT TAKE / _Exports/)#

Multi-format external project and stem interchange workflow inside the SESSION REEL view (CMD/CTRL + 4) that packages any recorded Take into .rpp project files, .als Live Set projects, <Session version="7003"> XML session folders, .dawproject open interchange archives, .fcpxml v1.9 video timelines, or universal Broadcast Wave (bext / iXML / MIDI marker / 24-bit 48 kHz minimum-phase impulse response) bundles. Writes to <TakeFolder>/export/ and links into <ProjectTag>/_Exports/ with either zero-copy relative stem references or self-contained copied/rendered audio stems and .nam neural amplifier models. See Section 7.2.4.

Ghost Slot (! MISSING Plugin Recovery)#

Non-destructive rack or instrument placeholder activated automatically when a Session, Snapshot, or Session Template references a CLAP or Audio Unit plugin that is not currently installed on the workstation or was moved on disk. Marked in amber as ! MISSING (! <Name>) in the 8-Slot Processor Rack or Zone-2 Instrument bar, a Ghost Slot passes clean audio so the session plays cleanly while preserving the original plugin_id, plugin display name, and saved binary preset state untouched across saves until the plugin is relinked via LOCATE..., reinstalled and rescanned via RESCAN DIRECTORIES, or replaced. See Section 5.7.4.

Gridless MIDI Sync & Looper Bridge (MIDI SYNC)#

Bidirectional 24 PPQN MIDI Clock (0xF8) and Transport (Start 0xFA / Stop 0xFC) synchronization system opened via the Top-Deck SYNC: FREE / SYNC: ARM / SYNC: CNT / SYNC: LOCK pill. Locks external drum machines, hardware floor loopers, AUX 2 Stereo Delay, 4-Mode Modulation, and the native Drum Machine to an exact rational sample span derived from either a 4-Tap Count-In (TAP (T) with optional AUTO-REC ON BEAT 1 and 23 Beat-4 warmup pulses) or a Freeform Floor-Looper Capture (ARM LOOP CAPTURE / LOOP STOMP / CC 80 footswitch, muting 0xF8 between Stomp 1 and Stomp 2 so AUTO-clock loopers never warble), with beat-quantized 0.5x, 1.0x, and 2.0x rational scaling and zero cumulative drift. See Section 2.7.

Hardware Direct Monitoring (HW DIRECT MON)#

Persistent studio monitoring preference saved globally inside device_settings.json for musicians who monitor live tracking inputs through their audio interface or stagebox's zero-latency hardware mixer rather than software foldback. Activated either from the Live Monitoring Latency Warning banner (Enable Hardware Direct Monitoring) or via the HW DIRECT MON toggle inside the Top Deck Latency & PDC Transparency Breakdown popover, where it can be switched back to software DAW monitoring at any time (clearing any per-session warning dismissal watermark). See Section 2.2.2 and Section 5.7.6.

Hardware MIDI Latency Ping (PING)#

1-click calibration tool inside Section 3 of the MIDI SYNC & HARDWARE CALIBRATION modal that sends 5 timed NOTE or 0xFA STEP 1 test bursts out a selected MIDI output port (USB or DIN 5-PIN), measures the exact acoustic return onset on the chosen RETURN ADC input channel (IN 01..32), and persists the median hardware MIDI-to-ADC delay in microseconds inside device_settings.json so calibrated external synths and drum machines land sample-accurately on Beat 1 via brief silent pre-roll (<= 25 ms). See Section 2.7.3.

Input Monitor (I)#

Per-track console switch (I on channel strips, MON in Channel Inspector, shortcut SHIFT + I on the inspected track in Mix Console) that routes the live physical hardware input (IN 01..IN 18) through the channel's 8-slot processor rack and fader even while transport playback is rolling, allowing musicians to rehearse or monitor live overdubs through console EQ, compression, and reverb. See Section 4.2.4.

Input Trim (TRM)#

Digital pre-insert gain control (-24.0 dB to +24.0 dB, default 0.0 dB) located at the top of every Input Track and Subgroup Bus strip. On Input Tracks, TRM sits upstream of both the raw multitrack stem recorder (rec/) and the 8-slot processor rack so you can fine-tune preamp gain staging before stems hit disk. On Subgroup Buses, TRM gain-stages the summed multi-channel signal entering the subgroup's SUB RACK. See Section 4.1 and Section 4.2.2.

Keymap View (KEYMAP)#

Interactive keyboard shortcut reference and customization workspace (CMD + 8 on macOS, CTRL + 8 on Windows and Linux). Lists all 62 bindable studio actions across seven scopes with live substring search, interactive Reverse-Search by Shortcut (FIND BY SHORTCUT:), scope filter pills, inline key-chord capture (ASSIGN / APPLY), scope clash detection, operating-system conflict warnings (OS WARN), and automatic persistence to keymap.json. See Section 8.3.

Live Mix (A/B Live Mix & Return to Live Mix)#

Automatic working-memory safeguard that preserves your live, unsaved Mixer state the instant you click AUDITION SNAP <NNN> in TAKES (CMD/CTRL + 5), docking a persistent 28 px AUDITIONING SNAP NNN banner across all workspace tabs so you can click A/B Live Mix or press BACKSPACE (Return to Live Mix) with zero lost fader moves. See Section 7.3.2.

Live Stereo Print (2-TRK PRINT / Print001)#

Real-time 2-track post-Master-Bus stereo recording captured concurrently alongside raw pre-fader multitrack stems whenever a Take is recorded with 2-TRK PRINT enabled on the MST MASTER BUS strip. Written to <TakeFolder>/mix/<SessionID>_Take<NNN>_Print<NNN>_<Stamp>.wav with automatic Plugin Delay Compensation (PDC) latency trimming, and convertible via Export… (Convert Print to FLAC / MP3) in TAKES to lossless 24-bit .flac or 320 kbps CBR .mp3 linked into <ProjectTag>/_Mixes/. See Section 1.1.3 and Section 7.2.

Low-Latency Monitoring (LOW-LATENCY)#

Top Deck monitoring mode (LOW-LATENCY in Row 2 of the Top Deck) that temporarily bypasses high-latency lookahead CLAP and Audio Unit plugins on record-armed (R) live monitoring paths and their downstream buses during overdubbing, paired with the Live Monitoring Latency Warning banner (Enable Low-Latency Monitoring, per-session Dismiss, and globally persistent Enable Hardware Direct Monitoring). See Section 5.7.6.

Mac App Store Edition (App Sandbox)#

Sandboxed macOS distribution of Cave Recorder installed from the Mac App Store. Uses native macOS Open/Save panels with persistent App-Scoped Security-Scoped Bookmarks for external library/session folders, defaults its Library Root to ~/Library/Containers/com.caverec.daw/Data/Music/caverec, hosts isolated out-of-process Audio Units exclusively (hiding .clap controls in PLUGINS), and omits bundled external helper/CLI binaries while still accepting loopback 127.0.0.1 connections from an externally installed caverec-cli. See Section 2.1.4.

Markers & Ranges (MARKERS / M001 / R001)#

Sample-accurate timeline cue flags and bounded time spans stored per Take and managed in both TIMELINE and the dedicated MARKERS workspace (CMD/CTRL + 4). Standalone cue markers (M005, ...) are dropped on the fly with M and navigated via [, ], SHIFT + [ (HOME), and SHIFT + ] (END). Ranges (R001, R003, ...) are bounded by start (K) and end (L) markers for Cycle Loop playback (⇄), Range-to-Sampler import (-> SAMPLER), and non-destructive Take extraction (NEW TAKE). See Section 6.3.

Master Bus (MST MASTER BUS)#

The final stereo summing strip on the right edge of MIXER (snug beside the last Aux strip in small sessions and permanently pinned right on horizontal overflow). Incorporates Master Tape Saturation (TAPE SAT), Master Bus Glue VCA Compressor (COMP), Lookahead Brickwall Limiter (LIM), Stagebox HW OUT | TAPE quick monitor toggle, 2-TRK PRINT arm switch, FLAC and MP3 toggles with BOUNCE offline Mixdown trigger, CLR CLIP, Master Fader, and 40-segment stereo Peak/RMS meter. See Section 4.3.3.

Mixer (MIXER)#

Primary studio mixing workspace (CMD + 2 on macOS, CTRL + 2 on Windows and Linux, default landing view for 0-Take sessions) combining the four Upper Inspector Wells with up to 32 Input Track strips (+ TRACK), up to 16 stereo Subgroup Buses (+ SUB), up to 8 Stereo Aux Returns (+ AUX), universal [M][S][R] Solo Gold strip controls, and the pinned MST MASTER BUS. See Chapter 4.

Multi-Camera Video Suite (50 / 25 / 30 / 60 FPS CFR, .vididx Sidecar & Multi-Lane Filmstrips)#

Sample-accurate multi-camera studio video recording, monitoring, and editing system supporting desktop USB/HDMI cameras (macOS and Linux) and wireless Cave Companion 1080p50 mobile camera nodes. Prefers 50 FPS (960 samples/frame) and 25 FPS (1,920 samples/frame) Constant Frame Rate capture at 48.0 kHz (with automatic 30 FPS = 1,600 smp and 60 FPS = 800 smp CFR fallback on cameras without 50 Hz modes, zero B-frames, 0.5 s closed GOP), saving .mp4 streams into <TakeFolder>/video/ paired with a binary .vididx sidecar index. Local cameras remain physically powered off (hardware LED dark) whenever unarmed, playing back, session-closed, or behind fullscreen modals, and illuminate a live Top-Deck privacy pill (CAM MON (LIVE), CAM ARMED (LIVE), or CAM REC (LIVE)) whenever active. Rendered in BT.709 on the Video Monitor and as stacked multi-lane time-anchored frame-accurate Video Timeline Strip filmstrips with 35 mm sprocket tick rails, 16:9 Frame Loupe pointer skimming, and a per-clip timing nudge slider in WAVEFORM TIMELINE. See Section 2.5 and Section 6.6.

Multi-Mic Phase Alignment (ALIGN ALL & Φ)#

Automatic acoustic arrival-time and polarity correlation processor that analyzes phase relationships across multi-miked instruments (such as a drum kit or dual-miked guitar/bass cabinet) relative to a timing anchor channel (0us) using sub-sample bandpass (150 Hz to 6 kHz) GCC-PHAT cross-correlation on recorded .wav stems or rolling capture memory. Clicking ALIGN ALL in the Top Deck (or Φ on an individual strip) calculates and engages sub-sample time delay (0 to 50,000 us / 0.00 to +50.00 ms) and 180-degree polarity inversion (Ø) to eliminate comb filtering, with single-step Undo/Redo support and instant global comparison via PHASE: ALIGN / PHASE: BYP. See Section 3.3 and Section 5.6.

Offline Stereo Mixdown (Mix001)#

Faster-than-real-time stereo render of an entire Take processed from 00:00:00.000 through the complete Mix Console signal chain (including updated fader balances, 8-slot inserts, Subgroup/Aux buses, Master Bus processing, and active Pass Lane selections). Triggered by selecting FLAC and/or MP3 and clicking BOUNCE on the Master Bus, saved to <TakeFolder>/mix/<SessionID>_Take<NNN>_Mix<NNN>_<Stamp>.<flac|mp3> (with a Xing/Info seek header on .mp3 files for web browser scrubbing), and linked into <ProjectTag>/_Mixes/. See Section 7.2.3.

OSC Stagebox Output Routing (4. OUTPUT / MON & Master Strip HW OUT)#

Fourth tab of the OSC STAGEBOX modal (4. OUTPUT / MON, showing !USB when USB playback is unrouted or muted) paired with the compact HW OUT | TAPE overlay in Zone 2 of the Mix Console Master Strip whenever a stagebox is paired. On 18x18 X-Air models (XR18, XR18V2, MR18, MR18V2, X18, X18V2), provides 9 selectable USB RETURN STEREO PAIR pills (1/2..17/18), one-click ROUTE USB <X/Y> -> AUX -> MAIN L/R (without ever auto-raising hardware faders), SET AUX RETURN TO 0.0 dB UNITY, and side-by-side HW AUX RTN and HW MAIN L/R faders (-inf to +10.0 dB, speaker-safe reset to 0.0 dB Aux / -20.0 dB Main L/R) with MUTE switches. On 2x2 X-Air models exposes Aux and Main L/R faders and mutes, and on X32/M32 consoles exposes Main Stereo bus fader and mute. See Section 2.6.3 and Section 4.3.3.

OSC Stagebox Preamp Control (OSC STAGEBOX / PRE / PRE! / HW GAIN / +48V)#

Integrated Open Sound Control (OSC) hardware stagebox controller supporting both X-Air OSC (UDP 10024) (XR18, XR16, XR12, MR18, X18, and V2 hardware revisions including XR18V2, MR18V2, X18V2, XR16V2, XR12V2, MR12V2) and X32 OSC (UDP 10023) (X32, X32 Rack, M32) stageboxes across studio Wi-Fi LAN (192.168.x.x) and direct laptop-to-stagebox link-local Ethernet (169.254.x.x/16). Exposes physical microphone preamp gain (-12.0 dB to +60.0 dB in 0.5 dB steps, labeled PRE on desktop channel strips, PRE! when a channel's USB tap is not raw analog, OFF when unpaired, and HW GAIN in the mobile Focus Strip and Stagebox modal), a 600 ms hold-to-toggle +48V phantom power safety interlock with live progress fill, hardware-truth connection with amber Δ session gain delta indicators, ramped session gain restoration (PUSH SESSION -> HW (RAMPED) / PUSH GAINS at 3.0 dB / 25 ms), USB send tap verification (SET ALL USB TO RAW ANALOG), and 4. OUTPUT / MON playback routing. See Section 2.6 and Section 4.2.2.

Overdub Mode (OD)#

Transport recording mode toggled via the red OD button in the Top Deck (or pressing O). When OD is off, pressing Record (R) creates a brand-new t = 0 Session Take. When OD is latched (illuminated red), pressing Record (R) plays back the existing tracks of the currently active Take while recording a new track-level Overdub Pass (Rec002-OD, OD 02) onto armed channels with automatic roundtrip loopback latency compensation. See Section 3.4 and Section 6.2.

Overdub Pass (Rec002-OD / OD 02)#

A layered or replacement track-level recording captured inside an existing Session Take when Overdub Mode (OD) is enabled on the transport bar. Saved as <TakeFolder>/rec/<SessionID>_Take<NNN>_<CC>-<TrackName>_Rec<MMM>-OD_<Stamp>.wav and displayed as OD 02, OD 03, and higher inside that track's expandable Pass Lanes. See Section 1.2 and Section 6.2.

Parameter Lock (P-LOCK)#

Per-step synthesizer macro override inside the native Virtual Analog Drum Machine (SEQUENCER on desktop and SEQ + SYNTH on Cave Companion). Holding any step cell and turning any of the 8 voice macros (or arming P-LOCK mode) locks that parameter value strictly to that step (with optional SLIDE interpolation to the next locked step and LOCK ◇ triggerless parameter locks that modulate decaying tails without retriggering the drum). See Section 5.9.3.

Pass#

Any individual audio recording on a single channel strip belonging to a specific Session Take, encompassing both the initial Base Pass (Rec001 / PASS 01) captured when the Take was first created and any subsequent Overdub Passes (Rec002-OD / OD 02, OD 03, ...) recorded into that Take. See Section 9.1.

Pass Lanes (PASSES)#

Expandable vertical sub-lanes under an Input Track in WAVEFORM TIMELINE (CMD/CTRL + 2, expanded with E and collapsed with SHIFT + E) and CHANNEL INSPECTOR (CMD/CTRL + 3, toggled with E or PASSES). Pass Lanes display the track's PASS 01 Base Pass and all OD 02..N Overdub Passes inside the active Take for one-click comp promotion (Use PASS 01 / ★ OD 02), per-pass muting (M), and non-destructive deletion (Del). Track-level overdub lanes are always called Pass Lanes and are never called "Take Lanes". See Section 6.2.2.

Phase Alignment Network (Zero-Slot Allpass Rotator)#

Dedicated zero-slot 5-stage allpass phase rotation network (one 1st-order 20-500 Hz low-frequency rotator plus four 2nd-order 20-12,000 Hz biquad allpass stages with Q in 0.30..3.50, default 0.707, and a clickless 10 ms dual-branch preset crossfade) built into the top of every Input Track strip alongside Ø and Φ. Programmed automatically by Mode 2 of the Polarity & Phase Maximizer while leaving all 8 rack slots free. See Section 5.6.4.

Phase Coupling Role (ACOUSTIC MIC vs. ISOLATED DI)#

Per-track phase-alignment classification configured in the Input Routing overlay footer. ACOUSTIC MIC tracks (default for physical microphone inputs) are grouped by recording batch and aligned together during ALIGN ALL, while ISOLATED DI tracks (automatic default for Pre-Tape Virtual Instruments and External MIDI hardware, and manually selectable for DI boxes) are excluded from multi-mic cross-correlation and stay at 0 us. See Section 4.2.2 and Section 5.6.2.

Plugin Delay Compensation (PDC)#

Automatic sample-accurate delay compensation engine that aligns parallel tracks, Subgroup Buses, and Aux paths whenever a third-party CLAP or Audio Unit plugin introduces internal lookahead buffering. Displayed live in Row 2 of the Top Deck (PDC: N smp (X.XX ms @ 48 kHz)) and detailed per channel in the Latency & PDC Transparency Breakdown popover. See Section 5.7.5.

Plugins View (PLUGINS)#

Dedicated plugin catalog and management workspace (CMD + 7 on macOS, CTRL + 7 on Windows and Linux). Displays every discovered .clap and macOS Audio Unit (AUv3 / AUv2) effect and instrument with a 3-way KIND filter (ALL | EFFECTS | INSTRUMENTS), live text search, format and status filter pills (ALL, AVAILABLE, CLAP, AUDIO UNIT, MISSING / NEEDS RESOLUTION, IN USE IN SESSION), custom folder registration (+ ADD SEARCH FOLDER..., + ADD .CLAP FILE...), hot directory rescanning (RESCAN DIRECTORIES), and one-click bundle relinking (LOCATE...) backed by clap_plugin_index.json. See Section 5.7.2.

Polarity & Phase Maximizer (Mode 1 & Mode 2)#

Two-tier multi-channel phase optimization suite that maximizes constructive acoustic energy across multi-mic instruments without moving microphone stands:

  • Mode 1 (Instant Binary Polarity Maximizer, < 50 ms): Partitions channels into connected acoustic groups and evaluates all polarity combinations (Ø) across four weighting criteria (Low-End Weight 30-200 Hz Punch, Broadband Loudness ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-Weighted LUFS, Transient Crest & Impact 60 Hz-6 kHz, and Anti-Comb Spectral Smoothness).
  • Mode 2 (Deep Multicore Spectral Phase & Allpass Solver, Anytime 30 s .. 30 min): Analyzes active performance regions across 256 frequency bands (20 Hz to 20 kHz) and runs multicore global phase and allpass optimization across all CPU cores to populate Candidates A (Pure Ø - Zero Dispersion), B (Tight Low-End Lock - Minimal Poles), C (Deep Multi-Band Allpass), and D (Full Wavefront + Allpass) with [GAIN-MATCH AUDITION].

See Section 5.6.4 and Section 5.6.5.

Polarity Audition Memory#

Automatic session memory safeguard that preserves your complete per-channel phase state (polarity, microsecond delay, and 5-stage allpass settings) before you audition Mode 1 or Mode 2 Polarity & Phase Maximizer candidates, restoring your exact prior polarity, microsecond delay, and allpass state if you cancel or revert. See Section 5.6.4.

Polarity Invert (Ø)#

Console switch (Ø, shortcut SHIFT + P on the inspected strip in Mix Console) that flips positive and negative waveform excursions by 180° (illuminates cyan when active). Used to correct phase cancellation on bottom snare microphones, rear open-back guitar cabinet microphones, or inverted balanced XLR cables, and set automatically during ALIGN ALL. See Section 4.2.2 and Section 5.6.

Pre-Tape Virtual Instrument (INST)#

Virtual instrument hosted directly at an Input Track's Zone-2 Input Stage ([INST] + [GUI] + MIDI status bar), supporting Cave Recorder's native Virtual Analog Drum Machine, cross-platform CLAP instruments, and macOS Audio Unit ('aumu') Music Devices. Renders upstream of the 30-minute true-stereo RETRO memory, the 32-bit float .wav Pass recorder, and the 8-slot insert rack, with graceful -120 dBFS tail-decay auto-sleep (INST: SLEEP at 0% CPU) and Pass playback isolation so disarmed recorded Takes stream cleanly without double-triggering. See Section 4.2.2 and Section 5.7.

Project & Project Tag (PROJECT / _Mixes/)#

Top-level workspace representing a band, artist, or musical venture, identified by a unique 1-to-8 character uppercase alphanumeric Project Tag (GF, TEST, MISC) and stored at <LibraryRoot>/<ProjectTag>/. Managed in the PROJECT modal (CMD/CTRL + O), each Project contains all of that band's Sessions plus a flat _Mixes/ index folder containing relative links to all active .flac, .mp3, and .wav Prints and Mixdowns across every Session. See Section 1.2, Section 2.4, and Section 7.4.

Roundtrip Loopback Calibration (Measure Latency)#

Built-in hardware impulse measurement tool inside the AUDIO SETTINGS modal (CMD/CTRL + ,) that transmits a calibration pulse out a selected physical output jack (Out 20 or Out 1) over a patch cable into an analog input jack to measure exact physical converter, ADAT, and USB/Thunderbolt roundtrip delay in samples. The measured offset is automatically applied as negative record-offset compensation on all subsequent Overdub Passes (OD). See Section 2.3.

Plain Studio Language & Universal [M][S][R] Order#

Unified 4-surface design and labeling standard shared across Desktop, Mobile Phone, Tablet, and Dual-Screen Pad Controller displays. Replaces cryptic shorthand with clear studio English (TIMELINE, MIXER, CHANNEL STRIP, MARKERS, TAKES, GROOVEBOX, STAGEBOX, REMOTE, SENDS ON FADERS / BUS SENDS / AUX SENDS, SIDECHAIN, SIDECHAIN LISTEN, POST, OVERDUB, ARCHIVE, SAMPLE HISTORY, MY MONITOR, FULL MIXER, MIXER LOCK, POLARITY MAX, MONITOR:, LOCK PLAYHEAD) and enforces the strict [M] (Mute Amber) -> [S] (Solo Gold) -> [R] (Record Crimson) strip control order everywhere. See Section 1.3.

Sample History (Sample History (N)…, Keep Latest 3 & Empty Trash…)#

Reversible storage architecture for Studio Sampler destructive commits (CROP, NORM, REVERSE, COMMIT STRETCH, COMMIT FX BOUNCE). Keeps only active latest v<VV> WAV files (<SessionID>_Smp<NNN>_<Label>_v<VV>_<Stamp>.wav) inside <SessionFolder>/samples/ and moves prior generations and soft-deleted samples into <SessionFolder>/samples/_history/ so UNDO and REDO restore previous audio and macro states losslessly without silent auto-deletion. Managed via Sample History (N)… (and an alert banner at >= 10 files or >= 256 MB) offering Keep Latest 3 and Empty Trash…. See Section 5.9.5 and Section 7.4.

Sample Studio Session (UNPAIRED SAMPLE)#

Built-in offline studio session bundled in Cave Companion (iOS and Android) and launched via SAMPLE STUDIO SESSION on the PAIR screen. Hydrates real pre-rendered 48.0 kHz multi-take audio, 2-angle 50 FPS video, sliceable sampler media, and a realistic sample Stagebox (MY MONITOR and FULL MIXER) state through the real studio engine across all Companion tabs while displaying an amber/copper UNPAIRED SAMPLE top-bar pill. Tapping UNPAIRED SAMPLE, tapping EXIT SAMPLE SESSION, or completing a live Wi-Fi pairing exits and removes the staged sample media cleanly. See Section 7.6.1.

Sends on Faders (SENDS ON FADERS / BUS SENDS / AUX SENDS)#

Cue and monitor mixing mode across Desktop STAGEBOX, Cave Companion Tablets (SENDS ON FADERS), Cave Companion Phones (BUS SENDS), and the Dual-Screen Pad Controller (AUX SENDS across Left E1..E4 and Right E5..E8). Reassigns channel faders (illuminated amber) to control each channel's send contribution into the selected monitor bus or FX send. See Section 4.5.1, Section 4.6.1, and Section 7.6.5.

Session & 08:00 Rollover Rule#

A single rehearsal evening, jam night, or studio tracking day within a Project (<ProjectTag>/<SessionID>[_<SessionTag>]/), defining the shared 18-channel hardware patch, strip names, bus topology, and console settings across all Takes recorded during that gathering. Cave Recorder rolls the session calendar date over at 08:00 local time so Takes recorded after midnight (01:30) remain grouped under the same evening session date (YYYYMMDD) as recordings started at 21:00. See Section 1.2 and Section 7.4.2.

Session Template (Save Template… / MicAndGuitar001)#

Reusable console configuration file (<LibraryRoot>/.caverec/templates/<Name>.json) saved via Save Template… inside the PROJECT modal (CMD/CTRL + O). Cave Recorder seeds four built-in studio templates on first launch: MicAndGuitar001, GuitarBassDrumTrio001, XR18Base001, and Empty. See Section 2.4.3.

Stagebox Mixer Workspace (STAGEBOX, MY MONITOR, FULL MIXER, MIXER LOCK, VIRTUAL SOUNDCHECK)#

Full-featured hardware mixing workspace (CMD/CTRL + 9) for X-Air OSC (UDP 10024, including XR18V2) and X32 OSC (UDP 10023) digital stageboxes, organized across 1. MIXER (SENDS ON FADERS, MUTE GRP, AUTO-MIX X/Y, MIXER → STAGEBOX / STAGEBOX → MIXER, pinned MAIN LR & SOLO / PHONES, and docked PEQ + 100-bin RTA + 31-Band GEQ), 2. ROUTING (4-domain 2D crosspoint matrix with 1:1 RAW ANALOG and VIRTUAL SOUNDCHECK), 3. FX RACK (4 stereo slots covering 55 hardware algorithms), and 4. SCENES & SETUP (stagebox_scene.json dual persistence, 64-slot hardware snapshots via FETCH ALL 64, and Cave Companion MY MONITOR personal IEM vs. PIN-lockable FULL MIXER governance). See Section 2.6 and Section 4.6.

Studio CLI (caverec-cli, caverec-headless, Python Client & 6 Studio Skills)#

Scriptable command-line and automation suite included in direct desktop distributions (installable in one click via AUDIO SETTINGS -> INSTALL CAVEREC-CLI & STUDIO SKILLS...). Connects over authenticated loopback 127.0.0.1 NDJSON RPC with 100% parity between a running desktop session (--live) and offline 20x-100x processing (--offline --session <dir> via caverec-headless), exposing 30 command groups, sample-clocked multi-point (K <= 4) Meter and Probe capture pipelines, POSIX FIFO bridging (bridge), the zero-dependency Python client (extras/python/caverec.py), and 6 embedded Studio Engineering Skills (caverec-cli skills). See Section 2.2.4 and Section 8.6.

Studio Coach ([?] Info Bar & 450 ms Hover Tooltips)#

Discoverability system combining delayed 450 ms hardware-styled hover micro-tooltips (automatically suppressed during active drags) with a toggleable 28 px recessed [?] Studio Coach readout strip below Top Deck Row 2 (toggled via ? or the Top Deck ? button and persisted in UI preferences). Displays the hovered control's full studio name, keyboard shortcut, role, and live modifier gestures (Shift+Drag, Double-Click, Right-Click). See Section 1.3.1.

Takes Dashboard (TAKES)#

Session management dashboard (CMD + 5 on macOS, CTRL + 5 on Windows and Linux) containing the session metadata and cloud sync header, the Undo/Redo history bar, the searchable TAKES CATALOG with clean 4-button rows ([Load], [Rename], [Export…], [⋯] including ARCHIVE / Restore and Empty Trash…), and the SNAPSHOTS table with global AUDITIONING SNAP banner protection. See Chapter 7.

Slip Beat-Repeat (SLIP)#

Momentary phase-locked performance roller in the Drum Machine Live Deck (1/4, 1/8, 1/8T, 1/16, 1/32, 1/64, REV GRAIN, TAPE STOP). Rhythmic divisions retrigger the real analog drum voices (preserving full velocity, Decay, P-locks, choke groups, and STEM breakouts) while true song phase keeps advancing underneath so releasing lands squarely back on the beat, while REV GRAIN reverses the most recent transient slice and TAPE STOP smoothly decelerates the drum bus over 450 ms. See Section 5.9.3.

Snapshot (SNAPS)#

Immutable point-in-time capture of the entire Mix Console state, active Pass Lane selections, and compact undo history stored in <SessionFolder>/snapshots/<SessionID>_<NNN>_<Timestamp>.json. Created manually via SNAP MANUAL (CMD/CTRL + S), automatically after every normal recording stop ([POST-REC]), or every 20 minutes during active editing ([AUTO]), and auditioned losslessly via Live Mix. See Section 7.3.

Spectral Spot-Heal & Live-Take Mistake Surgery#

Suite of non-destructive timeline repair operations in WAVEFORM TIMELINE (CMD/CTRL + 2) designed to salvage an unrepeatable live band Take without overwriting raw .wav stems on disk: [REPAIR CLIPPING] (smooth waveform interpolation for 1..8 samples and harmonic waveform prediction for 9..256 samples of clipped ADC transients), 50/60 Hz (45..65 Hz fine-tune) 12-harmonic Q = 20..100 (default Q = 60) comb hum cancellation, range-bounded Pass comping ([USE OD 02 IN RANGE]), pre-insert Clip Gain, [PATCH FROM SOURCE...] bar/chord grafting with ±50 ms cross-correlation phase lock, and [SMOOTH OVER ARTIFACT] (5 ms to 150 ms waveform and spectral spot-healing of mic stand bumps, pops, and clicks). See Section 6.5.

Split-Screen Video Mixdown (VideoMix001.mp4) & .fcpxml v1.9 Multicam Export#

Offline multi-camera video rendering and Final Cut XML v1.9 export workflow opened from the Export Video Mixdown & Multicam FCPXML modal in SESSION REEL (CMD/CTRL + 4). Composites up to four calibrated camera angles in BT.709 color space across five layouts (Single, Side-by-Side Crop with horizontal camera pan, Side-by-Side 16:9, 3-Cam Band, and Quad 2x2), bridges 960/1920-sample CFR video cadence to 1024-sample AAC-LC stereo console audio to write <TakeFolder>/mix/<SessionID>_Take<NNN>_VideoMix<MMM>_<Stamp>.mp4 (linked into <ProjectTag>/_Mixes/) alongside gapless 48.0 kHz .flac/.mp3 audio prints, and exports .fcpxml v1.9 timelines with both stacked split-screen lanes (<adjust-crop>, <adjust-transform>, <timeMap>) and native <mc-clip> multicam switching angles. See Section 7.2.5.

Standby Comp Lane (STANDBY COMP LANE)#

Any recorded Pass Lane (PASS 01 Base Pass or OD 02..N Overdub Pass) on a track that is not currently selected as the ACTIVE COMP LANE. Rendered in slate-grey waveform color with a clickable Use PASS <NN> or Use OD <NN> button that promotes the standby pass to active playback immediately without audio clicks. See Section 6.2.2.

Stash Kit & Reload Kit (STASH KIT / RELOAD)#

Live performance RAM bookmark inside the Virtual Analog Drum Machine (distinct from full console Snapshots). Captures the active Kit, Pattern, and Morph state so you can mangle sounds live with CTRL ALL and MORPH and snap back cleanly via RELOAD (Q:INST or Q:BAR with 5 ms click-free slewing). Overwriting a modified stash (STASH KIT*) requires a 400 ms hold or SHIFT + Click with 1-deep UNDO ST protection. See Section 5.9.3.

Stem Bounce (Bounce001)#

Faster-than-real-time offline post-processor render of individual Input Track channels (<CC>-<TrackName>_Bounce<NNN>.wav / .flac) and/or stereo Subgroup Buses (Bus<BB>-<BusName>_Bounce<NNN>.wav / .flac) written into <TakeFolder>/bounce/. Bounced stems start at exact sample 0 (00:00:00.000) with all insert processing, phase alignment, and Plugin Delay Compensation applied for delivery to external remixing or mastering engineers. See Section 7.2.3.

Studio Pad Surface (Dual-Screen Pad Controller / ● CONTROLLER)#

Direct USB hardware controller integration supporting dual 480×272 color displays with exact 1:1 encoder alignment, 16-pad RGB velocity/aftertouch surface, 8 capacitive touch encoders (E1..E8), 8 top soft keys (F1..F8), GROUPS A..H, dual 16-LED stereo level meters, and a 30-LED jog wheel ring via the standalone extras/encdr-daemon/encdr-daemon helper packaged outside Cave Recorder.app/Contents/ (disabled in Mac App Store sandbox editions). Switches instantaneously between [DRUM STUDIO] (including the 4-tab SAMPLING Studio Sampler workspace and SHIFT + SAMPLING STEM & SYNC) and [CONSOLE DAW REMOTE] (including CONSOLE CAPTURE & RESAMPLE, dual-screen AUX SENDS, universal [M][S][R] Solo Gold strips, and Range-to-Sampler import) via SHIFT + CHANNEL or the Top Deck ● CONTROLLER pill. See Section 2.8 and Section 8.5.

Studio Sampler (STUDIO SAMPLER / SMP)#

Sixth voice archetype in Cave Recorder's native Virtual Analog Drum Machine (Hot Coral Rose badge SMP, dedicated SAMPLER sub-view alongside SEQUENCER, SYNTH & SCOPE, and ARRANGER). Captures audio via Timeline -> SAMPLER Range import (DRY PASS or POST-FX), live direct-from-mixer RECORD resampling (TRACK, SUBGROUP, AUX BUS, MASTER, ADC IN with PRE-FX/POST-FX/POST-FDR taps and THRESHOLD 10 ms pre-roll, BAR SYNC, or MANUAL capture with zero Take clutter), or external .wav import. Features a noise-robust adaptive spectral transient auto-slicer (TRANSIENT, GRID, LIVE PAD), dual non-destructive APPLY TO KIT (AD-HOC / FILL EMPTY, CHOKE, opt-in +SEQUENCE) and APPLY TO TRACK (64-slice SLICE-LOCK with LINEAR LOCKS and RANDOM LOCKS), 5 playback modes (ONE-SHOT, GATE HOLD, LOOP FWD, PING-PONG, SLICE-LOCK), bipolar DJ FILTER / tuned COMB RES, per-voice assignable LFO, offline CROP / NORM / REVERSE / transient-preserving BPM FIT stretch / COMMIT FX BOUNCE with reversible versioned history in samples/_history/, dual-screen Studio Pad Surface SAMPLING control, and adaptive zero-scroll Cave Companion tablet and phone SAMPLER surfaces. See Section 5.9.5 and Section 7.6.6.

Subgroup Bus (SUB 1 DRUM BUS & SUB 2 INST BUS)#

Stereo summing bus strip (SUB 1 through SUB 16) that combines routed Input Tracks into a shared stereo processing chain with its own Input Trim (TRM), Stereo Link (LINK), SEL inspection button, reorderable 8-Slot SUB RACK (Tape Saturation, 12-Band EQ with Dual-Trace RTA, Analog VCA Bus Compressor, and third-party CLAP or macOS Audio Unit plugins), stereo Aux Sends (RVB and DLY), stereo Balance (BAL), Mute (M), Solo (S), and logarithmic stereo fader. See Section 4.3.1.

Take (TAKE 001)#

A complete, self-contained multitrack song recording or rehearsal jam captured within a Session (<SessionFolder>/Take<NNN>_<Stamp>[_<TakeTag>]/), starting at its own independent timeline origin (00:00:00.000, sample 0). Pressing Record (R) with Overdub Mode (OD) off always creates a new numbered Take (Take 001, Take 002, ...) and switches the active timeline to that Take. Two different Takes are never stacked on top of one another in the same timeline view. See Section 1.1.1 and Section 9.1.

Take Splitting (SPLIT TAKE & NEW TAKE)#

Non-destructive editing operations in WAVEFORM TIMELINE (CMD/CTRL + 2) and MARKERS & RANGES (CMD/CTRL + 5) that divide a continuous recording at the Playhead (SPLIT TAKE), extract from a standalone marker to the end (NEW TAKE -> END), or extract a bounded range (NEW TAKE) into a brand-new t = 0 Session Take while preserving all original .wav files, Pass Lanes, and phase alignment offsets with full Undo support. See Section 6.4.

Tape Saturation (TAPE)#

Zero-latency analog magnetic tape modeling stage built into every Input Track, Subgroup Bus, and the Master Bus. Models transformer core warmth, magnetic hysteresis soft-clipping, AC bias asymmetry, and high-frequency head self-erasure via six continuous controls: Input Drive (DRV), Harmonic Warmth (WRM), Tape Bias (BIAS), High-Cut Roll-Off (HC), Output Trim (OUT), and Parallel Wet/Dry Mix (MIX). See Section 5.2.

Tempo-Synced Delay & Modulation (SYNC / LCK)#

Musical subdivision locking (18 note values from 1/64 to 4BAR, falling back to 120.0 BPM when SYNC: FREE) built into AUX 2 Stereo Delay (Capstan Tape, BBD Analog with 600 ms physical clamp indicator, and Pristine Digital with independent R.DV right-channel subdivision and smooth tempo pitch-glide) and the 4-Mode Studio Modulation suite (16T to 4BAR LFO sync plus clickless proportional downbeat phase-lock via LCK). See Section 5.5.3 and Section 5.5.5.

Virtual Analog Groovebox (GROOVEBOX)#

Native 16-voice Pre-Tape virtual analog drum, bass, and sampling workstation and melodic polymetric Step/Scene Sequencer (CMD/CTRL + 6, across SEQUENCER, SYNTH & SCOPE, SAMPLER, and ARRANGER). Combines six voice archetypes (MEMBRANE & SUB, SNARE & CLAP, METALLIC MATRIX, MODAL & IMPACT, ANALOG BASS, and STUDIO SAMPLER), Storage-CRT oscilloscope, VCA Glue Bus, 64 polymetric Patterns (A01..D16), 16 phase-locked Scenes (S01..S16), 13 factory kits / 21 grooves, individual voice console STEM breakouts, bidirectional STUDIO CLK / ● MIDI coupling, dual-screen Studio Pad Surface control, and wireless Cave Companion GROOVEBOX + SAMPLER ([WAVE | SLICES | MANGLE]) remote control. See Section 5.9.

Vocal Rider (VOCAL RIDER)#

Zero-latency automatic vocal and instrument leveler (±6.0 dB range around a selectable -36 to -6 dBFS target) driven by a speech-weighted (250 Hz to 4.0 kHz) detector and protected by a Breath & Bleed Freeze Gate (Freeze Threshold, default -48 dBFS) that holds the fader steady during vocal pauses so live drum and amplifier room bleed is never boosted before the compressor. See Section 5.3.4.

Waveform Timeline (TIMELINE)#

Multi-track waveform editing and overdub comping workspace (CMD + 1 on macOS, CTRL + 1 on Windows and Linux) focused on the currently active t = 0 Session Take. Features multi-resolution waveform detail, AUTO ZOOM stepwise recording expansion, Full-Take Auto Zoom-to-Fit, active-surface 256.0 smp/px 1:1 zoom (0), one-handed 2D ruler scrub-zooming, expandable Pass Lanes (PASSES, E / SHIFT + E), dedicated MARKERS and RANGES lanes, LOCK PLAYHEAD / → PLAYHEAD, stacked multi-lane time-anchored Camera Filmstrips with 16:9 Frame Loupe skimming, Range-to-Sampler import (-> SAMPLER), and non-destructive Take splitting (SPLIT TAKE / NEW TAKE). See Chapter 6.
